English  Cost Control for manageable project costs  Without insight into costs, no grip on results. We provide control, predictability and better financial accountability. - Contact us directly Projects run over budget or returns lag behind? This is often due to insufficient insight into the relationship between progress, costs and planning. With good cost control you can avoid financial surprises and make timely adjustments. What is cost control and why is it crucial? Cost control, or cost management, is the process of monitoring, analyzing and adjusting project costs against budget. It is closely related to cost management: the broader set of financial control within projects. Well-organized cost control makes project costs predictable, controllable and accountable to the client, management and board. Especially in technical or long-term projects, this is essential to maintain trust, both internally and externally. cost control  How does cost control work within project organizations? Effective cost control starts with a reasoned budget, but it doesn't stop there. Throughout the project, we continue to test continuously: - How far along are we really in implementation? - What have we spent so far? - How does this compare with the original budget and schedule? - Do we need to make adjustments, and if so, where and when? We set up processes and reports in such a way that you have real-time insight into these dynamics. Not explaining afterwards, but signaling beforehand.  Earned Value Management (EVM): measuring = knowing Earned Value Management (EVM) is a widely used methodology within cost control. It links three dimensions together: - Budget (planned value) - Actual cost - Progress/performance (earned value). By monitoring these integrally, you gain early insight into deviations and trends. Vacancy: PhD candidate The Department of Neurology of Erasmus MC has a vacancy for a PhD candidate: Research on outcome measures for patients with neuralgia, for 36 hours per week. Job content Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) and chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP) are two serious forms of nerve inflammation. Patients with this condition develop severe symptoms and neurological deficit. GBS and CIDP are partially treatable but the response to treatment is often insufficient. The research you will be part of focuses on developing and validating a specific set of patient-reported outcome measures and other outcome measures for these diseases in order to measure and improve the effect of treatment and care. Work environment The study will be conducted at Erasmus MC in close cooperation with the Kenniscentrum Meetinstrumenten (Kmin, Amsterdam UMC). Erasmus MC is the national expertise centre for the care and research of GBS and CIDP. Here, a multidisciplinary team of experts works diligently to develop better care for these patients. jobs.description:
The R&D Center of a global leading ICT company, based in Amsterdam.

We are looking for a senior architect to drive the design and development of advanced OS-level system performance technologies and Hardware-software-chip co-optimization for next-generation computing devices.

The role focuses on system scheduling and performance optimization across CPU, GPU, memory, operating system, and chipset layers, balancing performance, power consumption, and thermal constraints. You will work across operating system, Hardware, chipset, runtime, and application layers, driving technologies from architecture and research through implementation and deployment on end devices.
Responsibilities

• Design and develop Hardware-software-chip co-optimization and integrated system scheduling technologies, including CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling, priority management, task grouping, core selection, frequency scaling, resource allocation, and performance/power/thermal-aware scheduling.

• Research and optimize application performance at the OS level, improving application interaction, responsiveness, animation smoothness, and overall system performance.

• Design and optimize high-performance core system modules and resolve critical system performance bottlenecks.

• Research and develop high-performance APIs, runtimes, application frameworks, and performance-oriented system technologies.

• Track advanced industry technologies and academic research and contribute to future technical roadmaps for system performance, scheduling, and Hardware-software co-optimization.

• Drive technical solutions from architecture and research through implementation, validation, and deployment on end devices.

Strong expertise in one or more of the following areas:

• OS or kernel performance optimization

• CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling and system resource management

• Hardware-software or chipset-level co-optimization

• Power- and thermal-aware scheduling and optimization

• Application or runtime performance optimization

• High-performance system, runtime, or framework design

In addition:

• Strong understanding of operating system architecture and system performance fundamentals.

• Hands-on experience identifying and resolving complex system performance bottlenecks.

• Proven ability to deliver measurable performance improvements in real-world systems or products.

• Strong problem-solving and engineering execution capabilities, with the ability to drive solutions from architecture and design through implementation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively across international research and engineering teams.

Preferred skills:

• Experience with Linux, Android, or other modern operating-system platforms.

• Experience with kernel scheduling, Dvfs/frequency scaling, heterogeneous computing, graphics/GPU systems, memory systems, or chipset-level optimization.

• Experience working across Hardware and software boundaries on complex computing platforms.

• Experience translating research or advanced technical concepts into production-level system technologies.

jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden
jobs.description: Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice between weekly and four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Development opportunities within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Leiden, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. At the start of your shift, you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel of the delivery van and head towards your first customer. At each stop, you select the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You greet the customer, hand over the groceries and provide friendly service. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next address. This is not a job where you spend your entire shift sitting behind the wheel. Throughout the day, you regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' homes and lift grocery crates. Driving, physical activity and customer contact are all part of the position. You complete your route independently, which means you are responsible for driving safely and handling the orders carefully. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I apply without delivery experience? Yes. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the delivery process and become familiar with the job before completing routesindependently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I need to work every Saturday? No. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. In addition to driving, you will regularly carry grocery crates from the van to customers' doors. You will also be getting in and out of the vehicle throughout your route, so you need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like to combine driving with an active and varied job in Leiden? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

jobs.description: Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Barendrecht. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time options. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. Your shift starts in Barendrecht, where you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to the first customer on your schedule. At each address, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully, provide friendly service and collect empty crates when necessary. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next stop. Driving is only one part of your working day. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk between the vehicle and customers' homes and lift grocery crates. This makes the role a combination of driving, physical activity and customer contact. After completing your final delivery, you return to the location in Barendrecht and finish your shift. Frequently asked questions Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. You will receive training before working independently. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague and learn how a normal delivery route works in practice. What are the working hours?There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Is Saturday availability required? Yes. You must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. You will regularly carry grocery crates and walk between the delivery van and customers' doors. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks throughout your shift. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Previous delivery experience is not required. Interested in working as a delivery driver in Barendrecht? Apply through Consolid for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the position, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

Do you want to know what a logistics worker does before you start working in the Netherlands? In short, a logistics worker ensures that products end up in the right place. This starts with unloading trucks and ends with preparing orders for shipment. A lot happens in between: scanning, sorting, packing, and sometimes driving a pallet truck or forklift. The job is physical, varied, and very suitable if you enjoy working with your hands. You do not need a diploma, and basic English or Polish is often sufficient on the work floor. That is why this is a popular first job for migrant workers from Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, and Romania. What is a logistics worker? A logistics worker usually works in a warehouse or distribution center. You are part of a team that manages the flow of goods. Think of large centers for webshops, supermarkets, or transport companies. There are thousands of these types of locations in the Netherlands, especially around Venlo, Tilburg, Rotterdam, and Utrecht. The role is broad. One day you pick orders, the next you help in the packing department or check the stock. Do you want to know more about what such a location looks like from the inside? Then read our article about working in a distribution center in the Netherlands . PCR vs Certification: Navigating Amazon's New Non‑GMO Requirements for Dietary Supplements  October 23, 2026 Amazon now requires all non-GMO claims for dietary supplements to be substantiated. Acceptable supporting evidence may include a polymerase chain reaction (PCR) test or certification issued under an Amazon-recognized third-party program such as IGEN™. Without valid substantiation, brands risk having 'non-GMO' claims removed, product listings suppressed or products removed from sale. For brands selling dietary supplements on Amazon, it is therefore important to identify an efficient way to meet these requirements while minimizing delays and administrative burdens. PCR or certification? While Amazon accepts both seller-supplied PCR testing and third-party certification as valid evidence of non-GMO claim substantiation, these two options offer very different operational and commercial outcomes for brands. PCR testing provides point-in-time verification and places ongoing responsibility on the brand, including managing documents, maintaining records and ensuring substantiation remains current as products, suppliers and formulations evolve. As a result, PCR testing typically serves as standalone evidence of non-GMO status, without delivering additional program or marketing benefits. Certification programs, by contrast, provide a more comprehensive, structured framework that supports substantiation requirements while offering ongoing oversight, consumer-facing recognition, and broader marketing value beyond Amazon compliance. Depending on the program, certification may also streamline enrollment and create recognizable trust signals that strengthen consumer confidence and brand positioning. jobs.description: Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Amsterdam. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21 and choose part-time or full-time hours. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online Home Shop Center at Beiraweg 6 in Amsterdam. Before leaving, you check your route and prepare the delivery van for the shift ahead. Once everything is ready, you head out to deliver groceries to customers throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. At every stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's door. You make sure the order is delivered carefully and provide friendly service during the handover. Empty crates may also need to be taken back with you. Then you continue to your next address. Driving is an important part of the position, but you will also spend plenty of time on your feet. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and lifting grocery crates are all part of a normal working day. The routes take you through different parts of Amsterdam and the surrounding area, so your surroundings and customers change throughout the day. After completing your final delivery, you return to Beiraweg 6, finish your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courieris not required. You will receive training when you start, and during your first working days you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the job in practice before driving routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I have to work on Saturdays? You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is the job physically demanding? The position involves regular physical activity. You will carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your shift. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed working hours. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Interested in working on the road in Amsterdam? Ultrasound and tomosynthesis are the most prevalent modalities used for breast imaging, and each has its specific advantages and disadvantages. Ultrasound uses sound waves to create a cross-sectional image of the tissue and has excellent depth resolution, but limited resolution in directions perpendicular to the transmitted ultrasound lines. Tomosynthesis uses x rays to create a pseudo-3D representation of the breast with high in-plane spatial resolution, but low out-of-plane (depth) resolution. Therefore, both techniques are complementary to each other.We plan to develop a joint system that will use the information from each modality to improve the image quality of the other, yielding not only a multi-modality imaging system, but a joint imaging system. The combination of tomosynthesis and ultrasound into a single joint imaging system will yield improved images from two independent and complementary sources, with inherent spatial correlation, allowing for improved lesion detection, even in dense breasts, and the direct multi-modal assessment of suspicious lesions. For this multi-disciplinary project, we will be working in collaboration with the Advanced X-ray Tomography Imaging (AXTI) lab of our Department, who will be developing the X-ray aspects of this system (see accompanying vacancy).In this project, you will focus on 3D ultrasound by using an ultra-wide ultrasound transducer that is mounted in a paddle required for acquisition of tomosynthesis data. In this way, a 3D ultrasound dataset can be acquired that can be used to improve the x-ray data by using the high-axial resolution US data. Additionally, the ultrasound data can be improved by using the high-resolution x-ray data. You will develop and validate these methods using both digital and physical phantoms, working towards first patient images at the end of the project. All of this will be in collaboration with a PhD student focusing on the x-ray aspects of the project, and industry partners to facilitate the translation of these methods into clinical evaluation. Tasks will also include presenting at international scientific conferences and writing papers on the newly developed methods and study results.RequirementsYou should be a creative and enthusiastic researcher with a MSc degree in physics, mathematics, engineering, Technical medicine, or similar.Experience or interest in physics modeling, inverse problems, and/or image processing, and affinity with biomedical research.Experience in programming in python, C/C++, Matlab, or similar.Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.Good to knowThe following should be included in your application: CV, letters of motivation, list of completed courses and grades, and reprints or, preferably, links to your thesis or any scientific publications or reports that you have written.The first job interviews will take place in November 2026. Please take this into account.

jobs.occupation: AI-informed adaptive mid-field MRI for personalized treatment of depression
jobs.description: We are seeking a postdoc for 12 months to develop an AI pipeline predicting antidepressant response from mid-field MRI perfusion and digital mood and symptom data. You will test the approach in a pilot MRI study, working towards making precision psychiatry accessible in clinical care. Depression affects many people, but antidepressant treatment does not work equally well for everyone. Predicting treatment outcomes early could help clinicians make more informed decisions and tailor treatment to individual patients. In this postdoc project, you will investigate how adaptive, AI-informed mid-field MRI, guided by questionnaire data, can provide clinically useful biomarkers for predicting antidepressant treatment outcomes. By combining artificial intelligence, brain imaging and digital mood and symptom data, you will work towards a more affordable and widely accessible approach to precision psychiatry. You will focus on three main areas: Exploring how adaptive mid-field MRI can reduce scan time and improve prediction performance compared with fixed scanning protocols, while remaining feasible in outpatient clinics and settings with limited resources. Designing an MRI-based prediction pipeline using perfusion measurements from relevant brain regions, acquired with arterial spin labelling (ASL). Developing adaptive MRI acquisition methods in which AI models, including reinforcement learning, determine what to scan next based on the information already collected. You will build on data from a large randomized clinical trial on treatment outcomes in major depressive disorder. Using these data, you will adapt existing prediction models and investigate whether mid-field perfusion MRI can support the early prediction of antidepressant treatment outcomes. You will develop an end-to-end prediction pipeline and translate your methods into an adaptive MRI strategy that can run directly on the scanner. You will also design and conduct a pilot MRI study in healthy volunteers, testia prototype model deployed on the scanner. In addition, you will share your findings with the scientific community and contribute to the further development of the PRESS platform in collaboration with consortium partners from academia and industry. Your responsibilities include: Adapting existing predictive models to explore the feasibility of mid-field perfusion MRI for predicting antidepressant treatment outcomes. Developing an AI-based prediction pipeline that combines MRI perfusion measurements with relevant clinical and digital data. Implementing and testing adaptive mid-field MRI acquisition strategies, including a prototype model deployed on the scanner. Designing and conducting a pilot MRI study in healthy volunteers. Writing scientific papers, presenting your findings at international conferences and contributing to the integration of your methods into the PRESS platform. You have a PhD in artificial intelligence, computer science, (biomedical) engineering, physics, computational neuroscience, technical medicine or a closely related field. You enjoy developing new technical approaches and applying them to clinically relevant challenges. In addition, you bring: Strong programming skills, for example in Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and experience with modern machine learning workflows. An affinity with, and preferably experience in, one or more of the following areas: MRI or other medical imaging, reinforcement learning or sequential decision-making algorithms, and clinical prediction modelling or health data science. Experience with perfusion imaging or ASL is an advantage. A clear interest in mental health, neuroimaging and translational research at the intersection of AI and medicine. Excellent written and spoken English, good communication skills and the ability to work independently and proactively in a multidisciplinary research environment. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A contract for 12 months. Classification in salary scale 1

jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer in AI-Native IDE & Agentic Developer Tooling to join a small, highly technical R&D team in Amsterdam.

You will explore and build the next generation of AI-native developer experiences — from intelligent IDE capabilities and coding agents to context-aware, tool-using and self-verifying development workflows.

This is a highly hands-on role with significant technical ownership. You will turn emerging ideas in LLMs, coding agents and developer tooling into working prototypes, evaluate new architectures, and help shape future product direction.
What you'll do

• Build working prototypes and technical demos for AI-native IDE and developer-tooling capabilities.

• Explore how modern coding agents handle context, tool use, planning, orchestration and verification.

• Design and prototype AI-assisted and agentic developer workflows that improve developer productivity and experience.

• Evaluate emerging IDE, LLM and agent architectures hands-on and translate findings into practical technical recommendations.

• Experiment with new approaches to context engineering, agent orchestration and coding-agent evaluation.

• Collaborate with universities, open-source communities, researchers and industry partners.

• Work closely with international R&D teams to influence technical direction and future product capabilities.

What we're looking for

• Strong hands-on experience building IDE, developer-tooling or engineering-productivity features.

• Good understanding of IDE technologies such as IntelliJ Platform, PSI, Lsp, or similar architectures.

• Practical experience with LLMs, coding agents, context engineering, agent orchestration, or evaluation.

• Strong software engineering skills and the ability to independently turn an early-stage idea into a working prototype.

• Strong engineering judgment and ability to evaluate emerging technologies beyond the proof-of-concept stage.

• Strong English communication skills and confidence working with international technical teams.

• Based in Amsterdam or willing to relocate.

Nice to have:

• Experience with compiler toolchains, build systems, runtimes, debugging, or developer test infrastructure.

• Contributions to developer tools, AI coding tools, research projects, or open-source communities.

• Experience building developer tooling for ecosystems with limited documentation, tooling, or training data.

• Experience with code intelligence, code completion, static analysis, refactoring, or program analysis.

• Strong technical communication skills and the ability to clearly explain and advocate for new technical ideas.

Why join?

You'll work at the intersection of AI, IDEs and software engineering, exploring how the next generation of developers will build software with intelligent agents.

Rather than simply integrating existing AI APIs, you'll have the opportunity to experiment, prototype and influence how AI-native development environments are designed from the ground up.

The position is based in Amsterdam and offers a competitive compensation package within an international R&D environment.

jobs.description: Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training with an experienced buddy. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop and become a buddy for new colleagues. A varied role combining driving, customer service and physical activity. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Almere, you take online grocery orders on the final part of their journey: from the delivery location to the customer's front door. At the beginning of your shift, you collect the keys to your delivery van and check the route prepared for you. Once you are ready, you head out to your first address. Navigation guides you between customers in Almere and the surrounding area. At each stop, you select the correct order from the van and check it with a handheld scanner. You then carry the grocery crates to the customer's door. You make sure every order is handed over in a friendly and professional way. If a payment needs to be processed, you take care of it. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you leave. Then it is time for your next delivery. You will spend plenty of time behind the wheel, but this is not a job where you sit down all day. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and carrying grocery crates are all part of a normal shift. Once your final order has been delivered, you return to the Almere location. You complete the route, return your equipment and leave the van ready for its next shift. Do I need previous experience? No. Previous experience as acourier or delivery driver is not required. An experienced buddy will train you during your first working days. You will learn how to use the van, scanner and delivery systems and how to handle different situations at the customer's door. How flexible are the working hours? You can submit your availability and work between 12 and 32 hours per week. Deliveries take place from Monday through Sunday, with shifts available at different times of the day. You need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. Is this an active job? Yes. Driving is only one part of the role. Throughout your shift, you regularly get in and out of the van and carry grocery crates to customers. You should therefore be comfortable with physical activity while working. Are there opportunities to develop? Yes. After gaining experience, you may have the opportunity to become a buddy. In this role, you help new delivery drivers during their first working days. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere You are at least 18 years old. You have a valid category B driving licence. You speak Dutch and/or English. You are available for at least two shifts per week. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. You are friendly and helpful towards customers. You are comfortable working independently. You drive safely and responsibly. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. Ready for a job that keeps you moving? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Almere. Questions about the position? Contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

jobs.description: Join Albert Heijn Online in Breda as a delivery driver through Consolid. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in and work a flexible 12-32 hours per week. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training during your first working days. Support from an experienced buddy while learning the job. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop within the role and become a buddy yourself. A varied position combining driving, customer contact and physical activity. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Breda Your job is to make sure Albert Heijn Online customers in Breda and the surrounding area receive their groceries safely and correctly. Before heading out, you collect the keys to your delivery van and check the route planned for your shift. Once everything is ready, you leave for your first address. Throughout the day, navigation guides you from one customer to the next. At each stop, you select the correct order from the van and use a handheld scanner to check the groceries. You then carry the crates to the customer's front door. A good delivery is also about service. You greet the customer, hand over the order and help if there are any questions. Depending on the delivery, you may process a payment or collect empty crates and returnable packaging. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to your next stop. This means your working day is not spent sitting behind the wheel. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and carry grocery crates. Driving and physical activity naturally alternate throughout your shifAfter the final delivery, you return to the Breda location. You complete your route and leave the van ready for the next driver. Can I apply without delivery experience? Yes. Previous experience as a courier or delivery driver is not required. An experienced buddy will guide you during your first working days. You will learn how to use the van, scanner and delivery systems and how to handle different situations at the customer's door. How many hours can I work? You can work between 12 and 32 hours per week and submit your availability. Albert Heijn Online delivers seven days a week. For this position, you need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. Is driving the only part of the job? No. Driving is an important part of the position, but you will also be physically active and have regular contact with customers. You scan orders, carry grocery crates to the door, collect empty crates and help customers when necessary. Are there opportunities to grow? Yes. After gaining experience, you may have the opportunity to become a buddy and help new delivery drivers learn the job. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Breda You are at least 18 years old. You have a valid category B driving licence. You speak Dutch and/or English. You are available for at least two shifts per week. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You drive safely and responsibly. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. Interested in combining driving with an active and varied job? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Breda. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

28 April 2026 - News For many internationals in the Maastricht Region, finding the right job can feel confusing and sometimes frustrating. We spoke with Sandrine de Goede, founder of Open Dutch Doors, about how to better understand the Dutch job market-and how to move forward with confidence. What are the main challenges that international professionals face when looking for work in the Netherlands? Language is often mentioned first. Even though many people in the Maastricht Region speak English with varied proficiency, employers still often ask for Dutch at a certain level. However, I think the bigger challenge is how internationals present themselves. They have strong experience, but it is not always clear to Dutch employers how this fits their specific needs. It is about making your value as an employee and as a person visible and understandable. Many internationals already have strong skills. Why can it still be difficult for them to find the right job? Internationals often have great soft skills, such as flexibility and perseverance. These are very valuable, but they are not enough on their own. Employers also want to see clear, practical skills. You need to explain what you can do in a specific role and why that matters to the employer. It is about connecting your experience to what the company is looking for. I work with a structured approach. First, we define a clear direction -what industry, what role, and which employers. Then we build a strategy around that. jobs.description:

The environment combines

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

Soft skills

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.

jobs.occupation: Senior RF/MMW – Analog and Mixed Signal IC Researcher
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mmw and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.
Apply 
 

Company
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics. Imec leverages its scientific knowledge with the innovative power of its global partnerships in ICT, healthcare and energy. Imec delivers industry-relevant technology solutions. In a unique high-tech environment, its international top talent is committed to providing the building blocks for a better life in a sustainable society. Over 5000 expert scientists from over 95 countries shape tomorrow’s world with their research which is typically 5 to 10 years ahead of the market. Imec is headquartered in Leuven (Belgium) and has offices in the Netherlands, Taiwan, US, China, Japan and India. 
The Imec RF/mmWave and High-Speed ADC group in Leuven enjoys a world-class reputation in advanced high speed ADC and in millimeter-wave (mm-wave) RF Designs. In these fields our expertise is in the design of record-breaking high sampling rate ADCs and integrated RF/mm-wave front-ends in advanced CMOS and III-V based technologies. The design group also performs research in the fields of circuit design for advanced (optical) wireline communication, future RF technologies, mm-Wave sensing for life sciences, and mm-Wave imaging. 
The circuit design group is technically mentored by Piet Wambacq and Jan Craninckx and has an established state-of-the-art research reputation that has been confirmed over the years by our extensive presence in top conferences in solid-state circuit design, such as ISSCC, RFIC, ESSCIRC, VLSI and CICC. 
 
As an independent research center, we collaborate closely with top players in both industry and academia, giving our people continuous exposure to both the latest evolutions in industrial challenges and approaches, as well as into the newest emerging academic ideas and paradigms.
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mm-wave and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies. 
 

Your key responsibilities will be: 
 
 

• Research and design of innovative high-speed, low-power RF and analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits in advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.  

• Drive the bottom-up evolution of these integrated circuits considering the evolution of scaling.  

• Together with the team, bring new ideas and new technical innovations based on your solid technical experience.  

• Take part in technical interactions with external partners and towards new prospects.  

• Publish your state-of-the-art research results in international conferences or journals.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a PhD degree in the domain of high-speed analog/mixed-signal and RF/mm-wave IC design or equivalent through experience.  

• You have solid design experience, and you have designed in advanced CMOS technologies (28nm, 16nmFF, 5nm).  

• You have experience designing in IIIV technologies.  

• You have a profound understanding of transistor-level circuits.  

• Experience in state-of-the-art high-speed analog/RF circuit design is a strong plus.  

• You are familiar with the various steps and tools in the design and layout of high performant analog and mixed signal circuits  

• You have solid understanding of solid-state devices, analog/RF circuits, up to the system architecture.  

• You have a broad interest in circuit design and are willing to contribute to multiple high speed analog circuit research domains  

• You can work independently yet in close collaboration with experts from other technical fields.  

• You have excellent reporting skills and can present technical results and choices clearly and concisely.  

• You can easily integrate into an international team.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities for your career development. 
 
 

• As a member of our Fab Engineering team, you will closely work with experts of the MES and related software – commonly referred to as CIM.  

• You have an active role throughout the entire equipment lifecycle, from automation specification during procurement, to requirement gathering after commissioning, to operational improvement after production release. You make sure that operations and engineering requirements regarding CIM integration are sufficiently specified and can be implemented accordingly. To enable this implementation, you need to understand equipment behavior and communication capabilities – which frequently requires exploration and diligent testing.  

• While technical knowledge and interest is crucial to be successful in this job, you will collaborate with hardware and software engineers who either deliver details to you or must pick up conclusions made by you. Data Specialist is a pivotal role, putting equipment communication capabilities into practice.  

• Commonly known as Industry 4.0 features, in semiconductor manufacturing such equipment communication feeds applications like MES, SPC, FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and AMHS (Automated Material Handling).  

• With this open position we are specifically looking for candidates who will work with Metrology equipment, i.e. measuring process results and product properties.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience.  

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials.  

• Prior experience in or knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You have participated in CIM projects, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You understand measurement techniques, why different equipment is needed to measure different properties, and how measurement results can be reported.  

• You have a pro-active approach and are solution oriented. You cannot wait to roll up your sleeves and dive right into the action. You easily work independently and are an effective team player as well.  

• You thrive in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.  

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment. 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers.  

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration.  

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios.  

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place.  

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You did apply concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. You understand the difference between instructions and reports. You know how to analyze data exchange with hardware units and debug communication issues.  

• You have strong analytical skills, are self-critical, and solution oriented.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English. 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required. You are a team player with strong drive to share your expertise and knowledge with colleagues. You strive to document and report.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer – Thin film and wafer metrology
jobs.description:
What you will do
 

Manage and optimize thin-film and wafer metrology tools, developing automated measurement recipes and ensuring equipment stability, quality, throughput, and safety. 
You will be a member of the in-Line Metrology Process Engineering team. This team is responsible for the standard metrology processes and tools in the cleanroom. 
 
 

• As a process engineer you will be responsible for multiple tools with a focus on thin film & wafer metrology. You will work on different measurement techniques like ellipsometry, reflectivity, wafer shape (bow, warp), four-point-probe (sheet resistance), microHall, etc.  

• You will create the automated measurement recipes on your tools which will be run by the operators afterwards.  

• You are the expert on the applications that you own and support the customers with your expertise.  

• You own multiple metrology equipment, and you will be responsible for process & tool qualification, the stability, and problem prevention as well as improvements in efficiency, throughput, safety and quality.  

• You will troubleshoot issues related to the metrology processing together with your colleagues.  

• You will communicate effectively with the stakeholders via multiple channels (IT systems, meetings, mail, etc.)  

• You will work in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts.  

• You will work in a shift regime, working in two shifts (Early/Late) including 1weekend (Sat + Sun) out of 4, to support the operations department which is working 24/7.  

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. PhD’s without industry relevant experience will not be considered.  

• A solid theoretical foundation and hands-on experience in one or more of the techniques listed below is an asset: 
 
 

• Ellipsometry, wafer shape metrology, sheet resistance.    

• Knowledge of the following techniques is a plus: MOKE, FMR, CIPT, MH, XRR, XRD.  

• As timing is critical in our business, we are looking for people who can evaluate and respond effectively to incoming requests and issues in a timely matter. A proactive mindset and flexibility is key.  

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong proactive communication and reporting skills are required. You strive to document and report your work to highest quality standards.  

• Given the international character of imec, fluency in English is a must.  

• Process & quality driven analyzer: You manage multiple priorities with a proactive “can do” attitude.

What you will do 
 

You will join our SEM-TEM operations team within the FAB, where we perform both in-line and out-of-line electron microscopy inspections. These inspections are essential at various stages of process development, enabling us to characterise materials and processes at wafer level with a high degree of precision. By delivering accurate and timely insights, we support our internal customers in developing innovative chip manufacturing processes that meet ever more demanding requirements. To achieve this, we rely on cutting-edge cleanroom facilities and highly advanced equipment. In this role, you will help ensure the health, quality and reliability of our microscopy tools through close collaboration with equipment suppliers and internal users. In short, you will support the teams carrying out microscopy analyses and contribute to the smooth and high-quality execution of SEM and TEM inspections. 
 
 

• As a SEM/TEM Hardware Assistant Technician, your key responsibilities will include:  

• Monitoring and following up on the overall health and performance of the tools.  

• Acting as the main point of contact with equipment suppliers to report, discuss and resolve tool-related issues.  

• Serving as the first point of contact for internal users when tool health or performance issues arise.  

• Contributing to the achievement of hardware performance targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).  

• Supporting statistical process control (SPC) activities for TEM tools to help maintain stable and reliable performance.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a scientific field such as physics, engineering, chemistry, or another relevant discipline. (or equivalent by relevant experience)  

• Hands-on experience with laboratory tools, microscopy equipment or micromachining systems would be a strong advantage.  

• You are well organised, able to plan effectively, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where multitasking and setting priorities are essential.  

• You are a communicative team player with a good command of English.  

• You are willing to work in a shift system, including early, late and night shifts, (24/7) as well as one weekend in four.

What you will do 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with developers of the same and adjacent software applications, Functional Analysts, and Business Analysts, to deliver a modern CIM application landscape.  

• Your primary contact will be the developer team lead, responsible for establishing our in-house development capability for the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, and we will assign an additional mentor during your onboarding.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial tasks will be configuration of existing equipment controller software modules, followed by developing clones of software modules for the same equipment type.  

• As we insource more functionality of the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, you will start developing equipment controller software modules for new equipment types. You will also be involved in developing custom solutions interfacing with the commercial platform.  

• You will participate in equipment model testing, both with software emulators as well as physical connection to the equipment hardware.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development, specifically related to hardware automation, and performing Java OOP.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You understand concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.

Operational Excellence

• Act as a technical bridge between Operations and Engineering to enable smooth coordination and handovers

• Support training, onboarding, and continuous learning within the team  

• Contribute to knowledge transfer by sharing insights on inspection data interpretation, inspection techniques, and tool behaviour

• Accurate and organized

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber optic sensing, combining advanced DTS and DAS technology, real-time data processing and smart analytics to monitor and protect critical infrastructure.
 

Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves monitors more than 1,800 km of subsea power cables linking offshore wind farms and power grids. The DALI product line detects leaks and intrusions in water networks. Fluves Corrosion assesses the risk of corrosion under insulation in chemical plants.
 

Fluves is a growing international scale-up, active in critical infrastructure markets around the world.
 

Our products handle high-volume DAS/DTS signals. Doing that reliably depends on a IT stack with a set of backend (edge) services that ingest data, orchestrate workloads, expose APIs, and integrate outputs into our application. We are looking for a software engineer to build and evolve this stack, ensuring secure, scalable, and observable processing from field deployments through to client-facing applications.
 

What you will do
 

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated software engineer for the following responsibilities:
 
 

• Take an active role in the development of the edge-server platform, application backend and API integrations. 

• Challenge existing poor architectural patterns constructively and bring structure. Propose, showcase and implement architectural alternatives to improve the computational flow. 

• Actively and continuously improve and modernize existing components, focusing on incremental, high-impact enhancements. 

• Extend the existing monitoring and benchmarks and profile the current code to identify and improve bottle necks. 

• Collaborate closely with colleagues in the product development team to design, build, and continuously improve product features in the edge and application layer, and deliver new integrations with internal, third-party, and client platforms. 

• Document best practices and clarify trade-offs to shorten the time to deployment of new data product features. 

Who you are
 
 

• Holds a degree in computer science or computer engineering, or has equivalent experience. 

• At least 3 years of experience. 

• Professional Python developer with proven experience with backend development in Django, Django restframework, Postgres and Timescaledb. 

• Track record in parallel computing and multiprocessing and/or experience with message brokers, storage backends and task queues (e.g. RabbitMQ, Redis, Celery …). 

• Understanding the limitations of computer hardware (CPU and GPU and disk storage patterns). 

• Knowledge of low-level programming languages and/or GPU architecture. 

• Preferably feels comfortable with scientific Python libraries for array computing such as Numpy and Xarray. 

• Some notion of the frequency domain and Fourier transformation is appreciated. 

• Clear and open communicator striving for clarity with a documentation reflex. 

• Writes unit tests, keeps (sphinx) documentation up to date, knows git and is familiar with CI/CD pipelines. 

• Uses AI tools as a standard part of how you write, review, and reason about code, while remaining accountable for the outcome. 

• Down to earth, hands-on problem solver that likes to take a deep dive into computational challenges. 

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Proficiency in one additional language — Dutch, French, or German — is highly desirable, along with strong writing and presentation skills. 

• Current residence in Belgium.

PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
 

Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of 
PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
 

About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
 

Your Mission: as a 
PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
 

 
 

Your Responsibilities:
 

Compliance & Conformity Management
 
 

• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation. 

• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects. 

• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables. 

• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities. 

• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.  

Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
 
 

• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes. 

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers. 

• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths. 

• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.  

Operational Readiness & License to Operate
 
 

• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution. 

• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation. 

• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks. 

• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and operational release. 

Education & Experience
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline. 

• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects. 

• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management. 

• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset. 

• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.  

Knowledge & Affinity
 

You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
 
 

• European product legislation and conformity assessment; 

• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles; 

• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF); 

• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness; 

• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements; 

• Occupational safety and statutory inspections; 

• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.  

Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
 

Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
 

Competences
 
 

• Translate complexity into structure and action. 

• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders. 

• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities. 

• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills. 

• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery. 

• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.  

Languages

• English: Professional proficiency 

• French: Strong asset  

You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

jobs.description:
• Be present on the yard and on board vessels on a daily basis to monitor activities, risks and safety measures. 

• Carry out safety rounds, inspections and audits to identify unsafe situations and technical risks, and quickly implement the necessary corrective actions. 

• Address and raise awareness among employees and subcontractors, and ensure safety rules are applied correctly.

#ontmoetingsdag

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Organisation

Guided by a sector-specific consulting approach enriched by innovation and technological solutions, we help our customers steer their transformation towards sustainable performance and a more resilient, responsible society.

We value a unique and strong corporate culture, imbued with the values of excellence, which contributes significantly to the success of organizations.

At inetum consulting, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.
