The opportunity

Our client, a Belgian federal public administration, is running a major digital transformation programme to modernise its business applications, strengthen collaboration between teams and build a more integrated, agile IT landscape. The programme is organised into domains, each led by a Domain Delivery Lead who brings several agile squads together around one vision.

We are recruiting three Domain Delivery Leads, each owning one domain of the programme

• Platform & Integration: the cross-domain technical backbone: integration, releases, Azure cloud, DevOps, security and data migration.

• Public Sector Transformation: a high-profile, politically sensitive public service domain.

• Digital Public Services: a domain delivering strategic applications behind core public services.

All three are senior delivery and programme management roles. You lead through influence, clarity of vision and trust rather than control. You will not be writing code or building infrastructure; you make it possible for several agile teams to deliver.
What you will do

• Unite several agile squads around a shared vision and keep business and team priorities aligned

• Create the conditions for autonomy and coach teams towards maturity (servant leadership)

• Build the overall plan with the teams, manage cross-team dependencies and arbitrate priorities transparently

• Run domain rituals: cross-team syncs, reviews and retrospectives

• Remove blockers by connecting the teams with the business, IT and other domains

• Manage change requests, report progress and risks to governance bodies and escalate in good time

• Manage suppliers as partners and own the domain budget

What the client is really looking for

• A builder, not a caretaker: someone who likes to create, evolve and unite teams, brings fresh ideas and challenges existing practices.

• A servant leader: you lead through trust, remove obstacles and help squads grow in autonomy.

• A strong business to IT translator: you explain complex IT in simple business language and turn policy and business needs into a clear roadmap.

• Proven at scale in the public sector: multiple squads, budgets and capacity on large digital transformations, ideally in government.

How you work

You influence without hierarchical authority, adapt your message to every audience, handle conflict diplomatically and stay calm and solution-focused under pressure.

Please send your CV or call elif and yasin to discuss further.

• 10+ years of project team leadership

• Leading large multidisciplinary teams split across several squads

• Budget and capacity management within public budget envelopes

• Business process reengineering and change management in digital transformations

• Understanding of application lifecycle management

• Public sector experience

D-NETWORK is looking for a permanent IT Desktop/Web Platforms Manager, Engineering Manager for a customer based in Mechelen.

You're Fluent in English with

• Minimum 10 years of professional experience in software engineering, including significant time (at least 3 years) in engineering leadership or people-management roles.
• Proven experience leading teams delivering complex, long-lived production software where reliability, quality, and risk management are critical.
• An expertise in the medical device or healthcare industry sector is a big plus.
• Contract in CDI/ Permanent role/ Employee (no freelancer for this opportunity).
 

Position Overview :

The Engineering Manager (Desktop/Web Platforms) plays a pivotal leadership role in this transformation.

This role is a technical people-leadership and engineering accountability role.

It is not a Product Owner, Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Tech Lead role.

The Engineering Manager partners closely with Architecture, Tech Leads, DevOps, V&V, QA, Regulatory Affairs, Product, and Delivery Management to ensure teams deliver medical-grade software safely, predictably, and at scale.

 

The primary purpose of this role is to:

• Build and sustain high-performing engineering teams

• Ensure predictable, high-quality execution

• Strengthen engineering maturity and standards adoption

• Reduce delivery risk and technical ambiguity

• Ensure compliance Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory obligations

Profile / Requirements

• Master degree in Engineering /Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical & Computer Engineering.

• Demonstrated, senior-level experience leading engineering teams responsible for complex, long-lived, production software where failure has material business, safety, or regulatory consequences.

• Proven record of people leadership over execution: you build, scale, and correct teams through expectations, systems, and accountability—not by being the smartest engineer in the room.

• Unambiguous experience hiring, developing, and performance-managing engineers, including senior engineers and Tech Leads; comfortable making hard calls to protect team and product integrity.

• Sufficient technical depth to challenge architectural, quality, and delivery decisions credibly, without acting as the architect, Tech Lead, or primary implementer.

• Direct exposure to regulated, safety-critical, or audit-driven software environments; understands traceability, reproducibility, documentation, and compliance as first-class engineering concerns, not overhead.

• Demonstrated ability to deliver predictably in environments with conflicting priorities, incomplete information,

and regulatory constraints, using disciplined planning and risk management rather than optimism.

• Proven capability to operate in global, distributed organisations, aligning teams across sites, time zones, and cultures while maintaining consistent engineering standards.

• Strong executive judgment: able to make, explain, and defend difficult trade-offs that prioritise long-term engineering health, patient safety, and organisational credibility over short-term wins.

• Ability to represent engineering reality clearly and without dilution to Directors, VPs, and cross-functional leaders, including transparent communication of risks, constraints, and consequences.

• Demonstrated intolerance for weak engineering discipline, hero-driven execution, and ambiguity in ownership or decision-making

• High personal standards for integrity, accountability, and professionalism in a medical or safety-critical context.

• Excellent command of technical English; precise, concise, and credible in written and verbal communication.

• Willingness to travel as required to maintain alignment, trust, and execution across global teams.

• Advanced degree in Software Engineering or a closely related discipline, demonstrating depth in software design, systems thinking, and long-term technical decision-making.

• Demonstrated experience designing, evolving, or governing complex software architectures in regulated or safety-critical environments (medical devices strongly preferred), with clear understanding of design-for-quality, traceability, and auditability.

• Strong working knowledge of applicable medical-device or safety-critical regulations, with practical experience embedding compliance into everyday engineering practices rather than treating it as a downstream activity.

• Credible understanding of modern AI/ML concepts and their application boundaries, risks, and governance considerations in regulated software systems (not hands-on model building, but informed leadership and judgment).

 

• Demonstrated ability to anticipate future technology shifts and guide teams through adoption decisions responsibly, balancing innovation with safety, maintainability, and regulatory expectations.

• Build senior leadership judgment by owning engineering direction, quality posture, and delivery capability where compliance and reliability are mandatory.

• Operate at executive level, balancing technology, regulation, delivery risk, and long-term organisational health with Directors and VPs.

We are recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing company operating in the service sector linked to healthcare, located in the Brussels region.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Jobomschrijving

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Permanent Control Officer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis as an IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) Specialist At BNP Paribas Fortis, our Cyber Security division unites the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Security and IT Filiere Production Security BE to design, implement, and maintain robust security solutions. Our mission? To foster a trustworthy, secure environment for both our colleagues and clients.

We’re seeking a proactive professional to join our IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) team, a key function within Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Here, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping IT and Business Units navigate operational risks tied to IT and Cyber Security, while reinforcing an adaptive, resilient control framework across the bank.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the guardian of data quality making sure the information we rely on is accurate, reliable, and ready to power everything from seamless customer experiences to cutting-edge digital solutions. Think of it as being the detective, the problem-solver, and the strategist all in one, working with teams across the bank to keep our data in top shape.

• Thrives on challenges. You don’t shy away from tricky problems. Instead, you roll up your sleeves, ask the right questions, and push for solutions that actually work.

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you will design and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions to combat evolving financial crime threats. Combining machine learning, graph analytics, and Generative AI, you will transform data into actionable intelligence that helps protect our customers, strengthen the bank's resilience, and shape the future of fraud prevention.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you'll design, build, and deploy AI solutions to help protect our bank and customers from evolving fraud threats. You'll work within our AI Tribe and collaborate with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to transform data into actionable fraud prevention and detection capabilities.

What You'll Do

• Develop and enhance fraud detection models using machine learning, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and graph analytics.
• Analyze large-scale transactional and behavioral data to uncover suspicious patterns and emerging fraud schemes.
• Engineer features, enrich datasets, and apply a data-centric and error-analysis approach to continuously improve model performance.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions.
• Investigate complex fraud cases, identify emerging attack vectors, and proactively mitigate risks.
• Leverage advanced AI techniques (traditional machine learning and also LLMs and Generative AI), to support fraud investigations and strengthen fraud prevention capabilities.
• Stay ahead of AI and fraud trends to continuously enhance our detection and prevention strategies. 

 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Education & Experience

• Master’s in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (PhD a plus).
• 3+ years in Data Science, preferably in financial services/fraud detection.
• Experience with fraud analytics, AML, or financial crime prevention.

jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Agile Production Services (APS) tribe is where IT Production happens. As part of a tight-knit group of 7 teams, we handle end-to-end Production Services, from go-live support to 24/7 on-call troubleshooting (yes, nights and weekends included).

Your role? The tech backbone of our digital operations. Whether it’s Level 2/3 support, application security, or hosting optimization, you’ll work closely with Infrastructure and Dev teams to keep our systems fast, secure, and reliable. No two days are the same - and that’s the way we like it.

AND IN DETAIL

As our WCM Specialist, you’ll be the go-to person for all things Web Content Management. 

That means:

• Ownership of WCM expertise: you’ll be the resident guru on TeamSite, headless architecture, and best practices. When teams need answers, they come to you.
• Building, integrating, improving: you’ll analyze, develop, or implement new components, working with Application Leads and integrators to push boundaries. 
• Keeping the Portal running smoothly: but not just maintaining it. You’ll help shape the future vision in our WCM guild (our tech community).
• Documentation that actually helps: you’ll turn complex setups into clear, actionable guides for stakeholders. No jargon-heavy manuals.
• Collaborating with architects: you’ll assist in cost-benefit analyses for new web implementations. 
• Security and performance first: you’ll play an active role in incident, problem, and change management. Finding issues, fixing them, preventing repeats.
• Setting standards: you’ll ensure every user, on every device, has a seamless experience.
• Monitoring and optimizing: you’ll track performance, spot bottlenecks, and keep things running at peak efficiency.
• On-call duty: One week per month (18:00–7:30), you’re the go-to person. But don’t worry: you’re never alone.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

What you bring:

• 5+ years of experience.
• OpenText mastery: you know TeamSite, LiveSite, OpenDeploy inside out, in an Agile/XP environment.
• Your tech toolkit:
• JavaScript, Node.js, NPM, React, Webpack, Jest, SASS, HTML5 are your daily drivers.
• CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Nexus). You automate like it’s second nature.
• Headless WCM architecture (especially TeamSite). You don’t just understand it, you make it work.
• Sharp analytical skills. You spot problems before they happen.
 

How you work:

• Team player, but self-driven: you take initiative and own your work.
• Fast learner: new tools? You pick them up quickly and put them to use.
• Open-minded and adaptable: change is the only constant in tech, and you thrive in it.
• Detail-oriented, but big-picture aware: you follow processes without losing sight of the end goal.
• Clear communicator: whether it’s tech talk with devs or updates for management, you get your point across.
• Persistent and committed: you don’t quit until the job’s done right.
• Comfortable in a multicultural environment: different backgrounds, one shared mission.
 

Languages:

• Fluent English (written and spoken) is a must.
• Dutch and/or French? A definite plus.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

Your responsibilities

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German. French is an asset.

What type of breed are we looking for? 
 

Our D2C channel is where we meet pet parents directly. No middleman, no shelf to fight for. It's how we build real relationships with the people (and pets) who love our food.
 

And it's not a side project. Our webshop is a serious business in its own right, representing a significant share of everything we sell, with a subscription base, a real tech team behind it, and years of compounding growth already on the clock. You'd be stepping into something that works, with the mandate to make it considerably bigger.
 

We're looking for a 
D2C & Digital Product Manager to own the roadmap that gets us there. You'll lead our Digital Product Team (2 full stack developers, a data engineer and product designer) and report directly to our Head of D2C.
 

You won't own the P&L. You'll own the roadmap that drives it, which in practice means you decide what we build, in what order, and why.
 

What is in your bowl? 
 

Own the roadmap that drives the channel
 

You decide what we build next and what waits. That means holding a clear point of view on where the growth actually is, translating it into a prioritised roadmap, and defending it when six good ideas arrive in the same week. You'll be measured on whether the channel grows profitably and sustainably, not on how many things got shipped.
 

Turn first-time buyers into a pack that stays
 

First purchase, subscription, loyalty. That's the journey, and it's yours to design end to end. Every step where a pet parent hesitates, churns, or quietly stops caring is a step you get to fix. CAC, LTV, AOV, retention and variable margin are the scoreboard, and CRM is one of your sharpest tools for moving them.
 

Own the campaign calendar
 

Product launches, seasonal moments, always-on lifecycle flows. You plan them, build them with your team, run them, and evaluate them honestly afterwards, together with Brand and Media.
 

Lead a team of four by example
 

Two full stack developers, one data engineer, one product designer. You'll set the direction, protect their focus, coach them, and raise the bar on craft. You won't be doing their jobs, but they should never feel like they're building for someone who doesn't understand what they do.
 

Keep us ahead on new technology
 

Including AI, and including whatever comes after it. You'll have an opinion on which new tools genuinely change the work and which ones are noise, and you'll put the useful ones in front of the team rather than in a deck.
 

Our stack 
 

We've built a headless shop on 
React + Shopify, with 
Klaviyo for CRM and lifecycle and 
Contentful for content. We design in 
Figma and the team runs on 
Notion. You don't need to have used all of it. You do need to be genuinely at home in a modern digital stack.

You're commercial to the bone. You can look at a roadmap and say which item moves LTV and which one just moves a ticket to Done. You've lived with numbers like CAC, AOV, variable margin, retention and forecast accuracy, and when one of them slips you know which lever to reach for.
 

You're hands-on in the engine room. You write the copy for the test yourself rather than waiting three weeks for a copywriter. You click through the feature before it ships. When the data doesn't explain the behaviour, you call a customer. Not because nobody else will, but because you want to know.
 

You've led a team of strong individual contributors. Developers, designers, data people. Specialists who are better at their craft than you are, and who can tell within a week whether you actually respect it. You've given them direction and honest feedback, protected their focus, and helped them get better at what they do. You'll be leading four of them from day one, so this one matters.
 

You live in the middle of Marketing, Design and Technology. You're as comfortable debating a campaign angle as you are reviewing a prototype or talking through a data model with an engineer. Those three worlds meeting is where you do your best work.
 

You prioritise like saying yes has a cost. Because it does. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, and you're the one who decides. You're comfortable being the person who says not this quarter, and explaining why.
 

You build brands, not discounts. You've seen what promo-led growth does to a business over time, and it doesn't excite you. What excites you is a customer who comes back because they love the thing, not because it was 20% off.
 

You know CRM is a craft, not a send button. You've built lifecycle programmes where the timing, the segment and the message all earned their place. You can tell relevant communication from noise, and so can your customers.
 

You get people around you moving without needing the org chart. Brand, Media & Partnerships, Logistics and Finance all have their own plans. You create clarity, you build the shared one, and people follow it because it makes sense.
 

You care about pets. Edgard and Cooper were real dogs, and everything we make still starts from one question: is this actually good for the animal eating it? You need to care about that answer. Ideally you live with a cat or a dog yourself and know exactly how it feels when the food runs out on a Sunday evening. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.
 

You bring 5+ years of experience in D2C, e-commerce or digital product, and you're 
fluent in Dutch and English.

• Around 5 to 10 years of business experience, with the ability to be operational immediately, without a training period.
• Proven expertise in one specialisation: group life insurance (including employee benefits), individual life or non-life.

Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

Opportunity

€63,000–€95,000 gross/year · Hybrid (2 days on-site per week, at client premises or company office; 3 days from home) · Permanent, full-timeThe systems that track assets, flag maintenance needs and inform mission readiness do not run on gut feeling, they run on clean data and sharp analysis. As Analytics Engineer you will split your time between being embedded at a defence customer site as part of a structured Forward Deployed Engineer team and contributing to the Product Engineering Team, turning raw operational data into the dashboards and insights that operational teams actually rely on. The rotation structure means you carry real on-site ownership while a full team provides backup and coverage; you are not alone.

Your Mission

• Own the SQL layer end-to-end, from raw source data through to production-ready models, with performance and maintainability as the standard.
• Build and maintain analytical and dimensional models that underpin asset tracking, maintenance workflows, readiness reporting and mission planning, datasets that operational teams act on, not prototypes.
• Author and publish dashboards and views in close cooperation with client stakeholders, translating operational requirements into analytical deliverables that are clear, accurate and fit for a defence environment.
• Apply Python for data transformation, lightweight analysis and integration glue work, keeping pipelines reliable and documented.
• Elicit and interpret requirements directly from French- and Dutch-speaking client teams when forward deployed, then translate those needs into concrete analytical outputs.
• Own testing and technical documentation during on-site rotations, with clean handover to the wider engineering, testing and documentation teams between deployments.
What success looks like

Over time, the client teams you support will reach for your dashboards first because the data behind them is trustworthy and the models are built to last. Requirements you gather on-site translate cleanly into working deliverables. Domain experts recognise that you understood what they needed — not just what they said. The components you build are documented well enough that the wider team can maintain, extend and take them into operational use without relying on your recall.

What you bring

• Production-grade SQL, complex transformations, modelling and query optimisation, not basic retrieval.
• Practical Python scripting for ETL, data transformation, analysis and automation; this is not a software engineering role, but the code you write must be clean and maintainable.
• Analytical and dimensional modelling at mid-to-senior level — this is the core technical differentiator for the role.
• Dashboard authoring experience in at least one BI or analytical tool; you will work with proprietary tooling here and ramp up on it after joining, so transferable experience is what counts.
• Consulting and requirements-gathering skills, when forward deployed you are the primary client interface, and the ability to elicit, interpret and translate operational requirements is essential.
• Professional working proficiency in French, Dutch and English — you will conduct requirements discussions in both French and Dutch and coordinate in English; all three are required for delivery and this is not flexible.
• Git discipline and comfort working in structured, security-conscious environments with the composure that client-facing work in defence demands.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role (we support candidates through the clearance process).
The language requirement and clearance eligibility are firm; for everything else, we consider the overall strength of your experience.

Nice to have

• Experience working with logistics, maintenance, asset-management or defence-operations data.
• Prior experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL in a data modelling or transformation context

As a Senior Support Engineer / Domain Expert, you will solve complex technical problems in business-critical customer environments, working closely with regional support teams, Cloud Operations, Professional Services, Product Management, Quality, and R&D. You will combine deep technical troubleshooting with strong customer engagement and take ownership of issues through resolution.

Beyond resolving incidents, you will help us prevent them by identifying recurring problems, improving our monitoring and observability capabilities, sharing knowledge, and contributing to more proactive and predictive support.

What you'll do

 
• Solve complex technical problems:
  
   
• Diagnose and resolve complex incidents affecting enterprise healthcare IT solutions.
   
• Take end-to-end ownership of technical issues and drive them toward resolution.
   
• Analyze logs, metrics, diagnostics, and system behavior to identify root causes.

• Collaborate with R&D and other specialists on challenging technical issues and escalations.
  
 
• Prevent tomorrow's incidents:

• Turn lessons learned into technical documentation and reusable knowledge.
   
• Contribute ideas that improve product quality, support processes, automation, and operational efficiency.
  
 
• Help the team and our services grow:
  
   
• Share knowledge and mentor colleagues across our global support organization.
   
• Contribute to the operational readiness of new releases, upgrades, and customer deployments.
   
• Represent customer needs and operational experience when collaborating with Product Management, R&D, Quality, and other stakeholders.
   
• Explore opportunities to use automation and AI-assisted diagnostics to improve customer outcomes.
  

What will help you succeed

You enjoy solving difficult technical problems and are comfortable when the answer is not immediately obvious. You combine technical curiosity with a strong customer focus and

 
• Take ownership and follow problems through to resolution
 
• Communicate complex technical topics clearly
 
• Remain effective in high-pressure customer situations
 
• Collaborate well across teams, cultures, and geographies
 
• Enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others succeed
 
• Bring a continuous learning and improvement mindset

Fluent written and spoken English is required; additional languages are an advantage. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or a related discipline is preferred, although equivalent professional experience...

We are looking for someone with:

• 3 to 5 years of experience in technical customer support, enterprise software support, healthcare IT, or a comparable technical role.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, ideally gained in business-critical or mission-critical environments.

• A good understanding of enterprise application architectures, networking, operating systems, databases, and system integrations.

• Hands-on Kubernetes experience, including supporting and troubleshooting containerized applications and environments.

• Hands-on AWS experience, with practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, monitoring, and operations.

• Experience analyzing logs, metrics, diagnostics, and other technical data to isolate complex problems.

• Experience working directly with customers and managing technical escalations.

• Familiarity with ITSM and ITIL-based support processes.

• Experience with healthcare IT is an advantage, but not essential.

PROJECT

You work within the multi-national research environment of the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the Royal Military Academy. As a university, we conduct research in various technological domains, including unmanned systems, land mobility, and landmines manipulations, aimed at enhancing user comfort. Our work balances the development of novel and beneficial applications with efforts to mitigate potential risks associated with these technologies. As a military research lab, we focus on applications in public security and Defense. Examples of practical applications include ground robots for detecting and neutralizing landmines, unmanned vehicles for patrolling tough complex conditions, and studies to improve vehicle and environmental conditions.

 

In this position, you will work alongside a large team of research engineers, each leading their own projects. Your role will be to assist in the implementation of various projects, by contributing to the related electro-mechanical aspects. Given our strong involvement in European-scale collaborative projects, you will punctually prepare and follow on-site test campaigns, mainly on military test sites in Flanders, sometimes abroad.

 

WHAT WE OFFER within the projects

• Highly varied job content, giving you the opportunity to work on a very wide range of novel electro-mechanical systems (air, ground, maritime) in a very international context. You will be deployed in a large variety of projects and will be required to work together with dozens of researchers and other technicians to reach objectives. To make this a bit more specific, you will be deployed as an example in these projects:
• TiPODS: To support the construction (steelwork, electronics, automation), commissioning, maintenance, and usage of a test facility for land vehicle tires testing.
• AURORA: To support the development of a new generation of demining robots with dual manipulators
• STRATUS: To develop novel drones that are composed maximally of EU-sourced & developed components
• Opportunity to work in and with an international & dynamic team of research engineers.
• The flexibility and freedom to innovate and bring your own ideas.
• The ability to have an impact and work on societally relevant topics. As an example: many of our research projects are currently seeking solutions for mine clearance in Ukraine.
• An employer that strives towards maintaining a good work-life balance for its employees.
• Training opportunities to get new practical skills and/or improve your current skills (potential example: machinery certifications, heavy trailer driving license, A2-pilot flying license).
• Possibility of travelling for field trials with partners.
MAIN TASKS

• Manufacture mechanical components for scientific research (machining, welding, etc.).
• Utilize specialized instruments (sensor installation, cameras, measurement devices, etc.).
• Conduct mechanical and electrical tests on test benches, ensuring compliance with international standards.
• Calibrate and test laboratory equipment for specific experiments.
• Actively contribute to all project phases, including metalwork, electrical/electronical work, technical drawing, and system assembly.
• Participate in test campaigns (including equipment preparation, maintenance, execution, and problem solving).
• Assist in procurement and maintenance of equipment (including repairs and calibration of instruments). 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

The applicant shall have a professional bachelor's degree in electromechanics (a level 6 qualification according to the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) or similar) and should have relevant experience in the field of electronics, metalwork, and mechatronics.

Explicitly, we are not looking for an academic profile but a technical professional profile!

 

This position is ideally open for experienced profiles (minimum 3 years of experience).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Proven experience with electro-mechanical systems and troubleshooting
• Knowledge of security measures to perform work related to electricity (certifiable BA4/BA5 or similar)
• Demonstrated ability to think outside the box and devise innovative solutions to technical challenges in the field (a "MacGyver" mindset). In other words, a problem solver
• Driving license B (or in the process of getting it).
 

¿RECOMMENDED¿ skills:

• Proven workshop experience and skills (ex: welding, electrical design, mechanical design, CNC, etc.)
• Proven experience with robotic systems and troubleshooting
• Training or experience in system integration
• Experience with electrical measurement devices
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:

• Experience in programming with Labview/ROS/Matlab/C++/Python
• Proficiency in 3D printing technologies and design software (CAD) for rapid prototyping and repairs
• Knowledge of PCB design and soldering
• Drone Pilot License can be an advantage and/or experience with flying drones
 

Personal skills:

• You are highly motivated (read proactive) to develop technical/workshop skills that are not yet mastered.
• You have a practical mindset, showcasing a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
• You take initiative, you are involved and result oriented.
• You are honest, loyal toward the institution and respect confidentiality.

About the role

You'll keep one or more defence software Squads moving, running ceremonies, clearing blockers, and turning Agile principles into daily practice, with senior Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches alongside you as you find your footing. This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), and the mentoring structure is a deliberate design feature, not a vague promise.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement, so your Squad leaves each session with clarity and a workable plan.
• Identify and remove impediments that slow delivery, escalating where needed and working with stakeholders to keep momentum.
• Partner with Market Product Managers on backlog refinement, sprint readiness and prioritisation so the Squad is always working on the right things.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to make sure documentation is planned and aligned with sprint goals, not bolted on afterwards.
• Monitor team health and track Agile metrics, using what you learn to support continuous improvement in ways of working.
• Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to surface and manage cross-Squad dependencies before they become blockers.
What success looks like

Over time, your Squads run ceremonies that feel purposeful rather than routine: the team arrives prepared, leaves aligned, and the retrospective actually changes something. Impediments get named early and resolved rather than accumulating. You start spotting dependency risks before they surface as problems, and your collaboration with Market Product Managers and Tech Writers becomes a natural part of the Squad rhythm rather than a coordination overhead.

• Working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, conceptual fluency you can apply in a real Squad, not necessarily a certification.
• Facilitation and communication skills strong enough to keep a room moving and surface issues without creating friction.
• Organisational discipline to track dependencies and keep multiple moving parts visible.
• Ability to build working relationships across multidisciplinary teams, including people in technical, product and writing roles.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role. ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is glad to explain what is involved before you apply.
If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The eligibility requirement for the required security authorisation is not flexible.

Nice to have

• PSM I or CSM certification, if you already hold one, great; if not, that is fine.
• Hands-on experience in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Exposure to Agile metrics and structured retrospective or improvement practices.
• Familiarity with tools like Jira or comparable Agile board software.

About UsZymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

The RoleAs Business Operations Associate your core role will be to take ownership of projects that matter, from first idea to finished result. The job is mostly project-based. One project might be a market study for a new crop or region, the next might be designing the layout of our new offices or setting up our company OKRs. 
You will often get a question with little more than a goal attached. We trust you to figure out the rest: to structure the problem yourself and to deliver work of a high standard.
 

What You'll DoYour main focus is on strategic and operational projects. You will:
 
 

• Take full ownership of company-wide projects, from scoping and planning to execution and follow-up. 

• Conduct market research and analyses, for example on new markets, crops, competitors or customer 

• segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations. 

• Set up and follow up on our company OKRs together with management and team leads. 

• Handle confidential information, such as financial, strategic and personnel matters, with discretion.  

As Zymofix grows, new projects will land on your desk.

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You hold a master's degree in Bioscience Engineering (bio-ingenieur). 

• You are mature and discreet, and you know how to handle confidential information. 

• You set a high standard for the work you deliver: well thought out, structured and well presented. 

• You need few instructions to deliver a strong result. You structure a problem yourself, ask the right questions and take it from there. 

• You enjoy project work and are comfortable juggling several projects at once. 

• You have strong analytical skills and can turn research and data into clear, actionable conclusions. 

• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both spoken and written. 

• A first work experience, for example in consulting or a startup environment, is a plus.

jobs.description:
Opportunity

Ensure the quality and reliability of our Defense Platform which offers a complete in-service support lifecycle for materials, consumables, and repairable items within defense organizations.You focus on validating Enterprise Suite functionalities, testing APIs, and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven EnvironmentYour work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.The Impact You Help CreateYou improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. Your work supports consistent and trustworthy outcomes.

Your Mission

What you will do:

• Design, execute, and maintain detailed test plans and test cases covering functional and non-functional testing
• Perform API testing
• Perform integration, regression, and end-to-end testing activities
• Identify, document, and track defects
• Support test documentation and reporting
• Work with development teams to resolve issues and improve quality
• Contribute to structured testing processes and continuous improvement
• Support automated testing activities

What You Bring

• Experience in manual and functional testing
• Strong experience with API testing
• Proven experience using Postman
• Understanding of testing methodologies (ISTQB foundation level or similar knowledge)
• Experience with test and defect management tools such as Jira, Spira, Xray, or similar
• Knowledge of test automation tools such as Playwright or equivalent
• Analytical mindset and attention to detail
• Strong communication skills in English
• Ability to work independently and within a team
Systems Thinking and Analytical StrengthYou understand how business processes, application functionality, APIs, and system behavior connect. You analyze outcomes and ensure that applications perform consistently across scenarios.Working Across Teams and FunctionsYou work with developers, analysts, and others stakeholders. You support collaboration and ensure that quality is maintained across the development process.

Opportunity

This is an office-based role. Candidates are expected to work from our office at least 4 days per week. Remote work is limited to 1 day per week.

Building reliable infrastructure from the inside

Reliable infrastructure is about more than keeping systems running. It means understanding how an environment works, solving problems at their source and creating systems that become easier to manage over time.As a System Engineer at ILIAS Solutions, you take ownership of the infrastructure behind our international organization. This is an internal IT position: you will not work directly with customers, but you will support the people who build, deliver, implement and support the ILIAS Defense Platform.You work across Linux systems, hybrid infrastructure and automation. Alongside day-to-day operations, you look for patterns: where recurring work can be automated, where configurations can become more consistent and where better documentation can make the environment easier to understand. The goal is clear: continue moving infrastructure from reactive support towards a structured, automated and predictable engineering environment.

Meaningful work

ILIAS develops software for demanding defense and security environments, and the people behind that work depend on reliable technology every day. As part of Internal IT, your impact is internal but reaches across the organization: you help create the technical foundation that enables development teams to build, implementation teams to deliver and support teams to help customers. When infrastructure is stable, secure and well managed, colleagues across Belgium, the Netherlands, Denmark and the United States can work with fewer disruptions and greater confidence.

Your Mission

What will you do?

• Manage and improve the internal server infrastructure that supports ILIAS employees across offices, teams and business functions.
• Take ownership of Linux system administration, including installation, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, patching and performance follow-up.
• Use Ansible to automate recurring work, standardize configurations and make infrastructure changes repeatable, traceable and less dependent on manual execution.
• Maintain Linux and Windows Server environments across VMware, Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
• Investigate complex infrastructure, system, software and network issues with an analytical mindset and a focus on sustainable solutions, not quick fixes only.
• Contribute to clear documentation, monitoring, backup routines, operational procedures and continuous improvement of internal IT processes.
• Support secure and reliable access to the internal systems and infrastructure services used by ILIAS colleagues every day.
• Work with the reliability, quality and security awareness expected from a company active in the defence domain and certified according to ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials.
 

What you bring?

• Proven experience as a Linux System Administrator or System Engineer.
• Strong hands-on expertise in Linux server environments. Linux is not a side topic in this role; it is one of the core areas where we need depth.
• Solid experience with Ansible, including playbooks, automation and configuration management.
• Good knowledge of Azure and experience with cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments.
• Knowledge of VMware and Windows Server environments.
• A security-minded approach to infrastructure and operations.
• Strong analytical thinking skills: you can investigate issues thoroughly, identify root causes and explain your reasoning clearly.
• A predictable and transparent way of working: you document what you do, communicate clearly and keep colleagues informed before, during and after changes.
• The maturity to take ownership, challenge unclear requests, ask the right questions and work towards sustainable improvements.
• A degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• At least C1 level in Dutch and English.

Opportunity
Ensure the quality and reliability of our PLUS Platform .PLUS exists so ILIAS can focus on its core business. We take on the opportunities, challenges, and initiatives that require new thinking, new technology, or a different approach. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."

You'll take on a variety of projects across different industries, broadening your experience along the way. As a bonus, you'll go through an in-depth training provided by Odoo.

Ready to start your adventure? Apply now

Must Have

• Fluent in English and Dutch 

• Strong analytical mindset, with an interest in business analysis 

• Good communication and negotiation skills 

• Autonomous, assertive & proactive 

• Affinity with the IT world, and interest in Odoo, ERP and Business Intelligence tools

Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

• A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
• An international and multilingual setting
• An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
• A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security

Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support

Access and security

• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures

• Tickets, escalation and coordination

• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity
Assets

• Knowledge of Arabic
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
• IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)
Soft skills

• Customer focus and service mindset
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management
• Clear communication with non-technical users
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

• Experience in method development, validation, and transfer under GMP conditions.  

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements (ICH Q2, Q3, FDA/EMA guidance on nitrosamines) and GMP principles.

About Us: 
 

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities:
 

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Production Technician to join our microbial production team. In this role, you will play a key part in producing beneficial microorganisms used in biostimulant, biocontrol, and biofertilizer products that support healthy crop growth. Training will be provided, so prior microbiology experience is not required — though it's a plus. Curiosity and attention to detail matter most.
 

 
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• You independently carry out production tasks according to standard procedures: you prepare supplies, sterilize, inoculate, harvest and handle downstream processing. 

• You work under sterile conditions and strictly follow hygiene and sterility protocols, giving contamination no chance. 

• You safeguard product quality at every stage by performing in-process quality and sterility checks. 

• You help with downstream processing and carry out quantification checks as part of the final quality control. 

• You actively contribute to continuous improvement (TPM) and help find solutions when problems arise. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You have a technical or scientific background: a secondary school diploma, an associate degree (graduaat) or equivalent practical experience. 

• You enjoy steady, hands-on work and feel right at home in it. 

• You understand the basics of microbiology: you know what bacteria and fungi are and how contamination occurs, and you're interested in sterility and hygiene. 

• Repetitive tasks don't put you off: you stay focused and precise, even over long periods. 

• You can stand for extended periods and regularly lift and carry moderate loads without difficulty. 

• Have you worked with an ELN (Electronic Lab Notebook) before? That's a plus, but we'll train you either way. 

• You're responsible, reliable and a true team player, and safety and hygiene in the workplace come naturally to you.

Strong interpersonal skills and a good command of English.

For one of our fastest growing practices we are looking for a Data Quality Assurance Specialist. 

Do you have 3 to 5 years of experience of which at least 2 to 3 years in the field of data analysis and/or data quality? And the prospect of helping to grow a company that believes in together creating an impact with Data at our customers sounds good?

Who are we?

In today’s digital world, organizations need to shift their approach to cyber security. Prevention alone is no longer sufficient. The ability to rapidly detect and respond to threats is essential. Organizations are increasingly turning to trusted strategic partners who can fully unburden them in the domain of detection and response.

That’s where we come in. We offer MDR as a value service to a broad spectrum of customers across different verticals – all equally exciting.

Based in Belgium and the Netherlands, we help companies navigate the digital era and make data-driven decisions with confidence. We proudly serve clients in the top 200 across the Benelux, spanning a wide range of fascinating and diverse sectors.

At Davinsi Labs, we love to inspire each other, collaborate closely, and pursue excellence together. We are building a workplace where fulfillment and happiness take center stage.

Your mission: what can you expect from the job?

Automation Lifecycle Management

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. • Inform customers about import regulations and legislation, including shipping terms, transportation methods, payment terms, customs-related documentation, etc. 

• Coordinate the entire order-to-cash process 

• Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain and Operations to ensure that all orders are processed correctly 

• Organize export shipments: book and coordinate shipments, manage transport and customs documentation, invoicing and delivery follow-up 

• Monitor order parameters and inventory levels to ensure sufficient stock availability

I-Coats
 

I-Coats NV is an internationally active SME, founded in 2006 and based in Berchem (Antwerp), Belgium. With a team of approximately 10 employees, the company develops and commercializes innovative overlay finishes and coatings for ropes, nets and steel cables. Through production partners, its products are supplied worldwide to customers across Europe, the United States, Canada, China and Korea. With an annual turnover of €6 million and 90% export activity, 
I-Coats is a dynamic and internationally oriented company with strong growth ambitions.
 

To strengthen the team, we are looking for an experienced and technically strong: 
Project Manager
 

Your role 
 

In this role, you will take a leading position in the development of coatings for customer-specific applications, operating at the intersection of R&D and practical implementation. You will act both as a technical expert and as a project lead, playing a key role in translating customer needs into high-performance and innovative coating solutions.

Project Manager, you will be end-to-end responsible for the development and implementation of tailor-made coatings for industrial applications.
 

Your responsibilities

• Analyze technical challenges and translate them into concrete development and testing trajectories.

• Ensure a smooth transition from laboratory results to effective production and closely monitor the implementation process. 

• Safeguard technical know-how and actively contribute to the further development of expertise within 
I-Coats’ product niche.

About you and this role
 

At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.

Seneffe, Belgium.
 

In this role, you will apply advanced analytical techniques to solve complex challenges in industrial chemistry and materials science. Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation.
 

As a subject matter expert in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, you will lead analytical investigations, develop new measurement methodologies in a world class NMR lab with global resources, and enhance existing analytical capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across a diverse global network while supporting multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.
 

Responsibilities

jobs.description:
We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Technical Customer Success Manager - DACH Market (m/f/d)

 Your Role

As Technical Customer Success Manager for the DACH market, you are the primary point of contact for your customer cohort (of SMBs) once they've signed. You own their success, satisfaction, and retention end to end.

You actively build relationships, identify value drivers, and ensure every customer gets the most out of fonio. You'll spend most of your time in calls and meetings with customers and implementing or improving their setups.

 

What to expect

 * Own a portfolio of DACH SMB customers across their full lifecycle

 * Build relationships, surface value, and find new use cases for AI agents to keep customers engaged

 * Support customers in setting up their AI assistant; implement workflows for medium complex cases and coordinate with developers for advanced setups

 * Run check-ins and proactive calls based on usage signals (low engagement, expansion opportunities, setup friction)

 * Work with a ready-made pipeline and clear playbooks, with room to test your own initiatives

 * Maximize the value generated from each customer in your portfolio

 * Spot churn risks early and act on them

 * Manage your activity autonomously in HubSpot

 

Who We're Looking For

 * 2-5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, Forward Deployment Engineer or a technical client-facing SaaS/B2B role

 * Ideally a strong technical understanding - comfortable understanding API documentation and error logs to troubleshoot customer setup issues independently

 ** Experience with tools like n8n, http://make.com/, codex or similar

 * An affinity for tech / AI products is a real plus

 * strong English

 * Structured, autonomous, results-driven

 * You build trust easily with customers, by phone or video

 * You take initiative, test, iterate, and don't wait to be told what to do

 * Comfortable with CRM (ideally HubSpot) and data-driven workflows

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna for 1-2 months initially

jobs.occupation: Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders), Österreichische Rundfunksender GmbH (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: From DEV bench to center stage -- build the future of streaming.   At BIG BLUE MARBLE, we enable easy access to broadcast content in Austria while driving innovation and customer service in media delivery. Our mission is to actively shape the digital future of TV and radio. By continuously optimizing the media experience for our customers, we provide innovative streaming solutions while pursuing sustainable practices for a climate-friendly broadcasting landscape. To lead our Innovation & Research LAB -- publicly known as BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (labs.bigbluemarble.com) -- at ORS comm GmbH & Co KG, we are looking for a: Program Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders Are you a developer at heart who's ready for the next chapter -- one where you spend less time in the IDE and more time shaping which technologies your company bets on next? Do you want to turn prototypes into real business impact, represent your company on international stages, and build the innovation ecosystem of a streaming platform from the ground up? If you have a technical background and the ambition to grow into a coordinating, outward-facing leadership role, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs is where you belong. Your responsibilities:   Innovation  Scouting Innovation is not an end in itself for us. We want to understand early which technologies will shape the streaming world of tomorrow -- and which of them are actually relevant for our platform and our customers. You scout new technologies, solutions, start-ups, and trends in the streaming and media-tech space. You analyze technological developments and assess their relevance and potential applications for our products. You attend industry conferences, trade fairs, and events at home and abroad, build a relevant network, and bring fresh impulses into the company. You work closely with our Innovation Management and Professional Services team to move promising technologies from first assessment through to potential Proofs of Concept. You translate your findings into clear, digestible formats and share your knowledge internally and externally -- through technical blog posts, presentations, or trend and technology analyses. AI and automation are a permanent part of your technology radar -- always with an eye on concrete use cases in the streaming and platform environment. Innovation Lab & Proof of Concept Program You lead the operational activities of BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs and coordinate its day-to-day innovation processes. You organize and facilitate our bi-weekly Proof of Concept (PoC) sprints together with our Full Stack Development team. Together with Product Management, you evaluate ideas entering the innovation funnel, prioritize opportunities, and initiate new PoCs. You coordinate PoCs from idea validation to successful completion, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective collaboration across technical and business teams. You make sure PoC outcomes are properly documented and turned into reusable knowledge, technical assets, or follow-up initiatives. You continuously improve our Lab processes, fostering an agile, execution-oriented innovation culture. Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem -- universities, research institutions, public organizations, start-ups, and technology partners. You act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation and research initiatives. You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events, expanding our professional network and visibility. You contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting new partnerships and innovation opportunities. Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication You ensure innovation outcomes are communicated effectively, internally and externally. You support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination formats. You prepare management-ready summaries, technology assessments, and recommendations based on PoC results and emerging technology trends. You promote knowledge sharing across teams and help translate innovation into long-term business value. Your background: A technical foundation, not necessarily a management CV. You have worked as a (Full Stack) Software Developer, Engineer, or in a comparable hands-on technical role -- and you understand modern software development, cloud technologies, and digital platforms from the inside. A Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a comparable technical discipline -- helpful for writing well-founded technical papers and conference contributions. Equivalent professional experience is welcome in place of a formal degree. A genuine wish to change direction: you're ready to trade day-to-day coding for coordinating people, representing the company externally, and shaping innovation strategy. Prior exposure to project or product coordination is a plus, not a requirement. Streaming and broadcast media know-how is very welcome -- but if you bring strong technical fundamentals, we're confident you can build this knowledge quickly on the job. You're comfortable presenting, networking, and representing BIG BLUE MARBLE confidently in front of external audiences -- at conferences, workshops, and partner meetings. You enjoy structuring ambiguous, early-stage ideas, coordinating people across disciplines, and turning promising concepts into tangible outcomes. Experience contributing to technical blogs, conference papers, white papers, or presentations is a strong asset. Comfortable working in agile environments and facilitating sprint-based collaboration. Experience with universities, research institutions, start-ups, or technology partners is a plus. Fluent English (C1/C2) and German (minimum B2) are required. What we're proposing for you: In addition to an annual salary in line with the market, we offer you a package of benefits consisting of a mobility allowance for the Wiener Linien annual ticket or the KLIMATICKET, a company canteen, our bonus programme, the pension fund and a sports programme. Place of work: Vienna (remote option), working hours: 38,5hours per week, reference number: OC1026CINSE, starting date: 10/2026. We are happy to offer professionals with relevant training and experience a gross annual salary in line with the market of between 56,000 and 72,000 euros (salary group 4, Telekom-KV, 38,5 h/week)*. Remote work Good communication and direct cooperation are very important to us. You can work from home, from the modern office or hybrid. In practice, this means that, according to your preferences, you will benefit from working remotely or from an office in Vienna with a great location and a cool atmosphere. We are happy to talk about the details in a meeting.  Travel This position includes occasional national and international business travel, with an expected travel commitment of up to four weeks per year, primarily for conferences, trade fairs, workshops, partner meetings, and industry events. *For legal reasons, we are required to state the minimum salary as per the collective agreement. For this position, it is  EUR 3.523,02 gross/month (Qualification Group 4, Specialist Level, Telekom collective agreement 2026, full-time).  Why join us: You're passionate about media technology and want your career to move from building things to shaping what gets built next. You bring a technical foundation, curiosity about streaming and broadcasting, and the communication skills to be a trusted voice -- internally and externally. Analytical thinking, the ability to navigate complex, ambiguous topics, and genuine enthusiasm for realization complete your profile. This is you?  Contact us via karriere.ors.at  We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and especially welcome individuals from underrepresented groups.
